name: The Dance of the Red Rose
source:
[b]When the clock strikes midnight, the Dance of the Red Rose begins. [/b]

Princess Briar is finally of age to attend the illustrious Dance of the Red Rose, having dreamed of taking part since she was a child. There is just one problem, she does not have a dance partner! Will you help her confess her blooming feelings to one of the guests and secure a place on the ballroom dance floor?

[From [url=https://bcac.itch.io/the-dance-of-the-red-rose]itch.io[/url]]
